body.x: HISENSE(www.hisense.com) unveiled 6.8inch smartphone 'X1' at 'CES 2014', the biggest IT appliances show held in Las Vegas, U.S. from January 7th to 10th.

It's features a 6.8 inch monitor, 1920 x 1080 pixel display, a Qualcomm Snapdragon 800 quad-core processor, 2GB of RAM, and 16GB of storage. It runs Andorid 4.3 Jelly Bean, has a 13MP rear camera and 5MP front camera and it’s powered by a 3900mAh battery.

'CES 2014(The International Consumer Electronics Show)' is owned and produced by the Consumer Electronics Association (CEA), the technology trade association. CES showcases 2,500 ~ 3,200 exhibitors in every kind of electronic appliance. More than 152,000 attendees from more than 150 countries come to the show.
